en: Come see me again when you're a little less loaded down. I'll be here.
That could be fun. I'd be up for some fishing as long as you've got room.
Of course there's room! Let's hit the waves, then!
No, I think I'll pass for now.
You sure? Well, the offer's open if you change your mind later. I won't go anywhere just yet.
Oh, you finished for now?
Yeah. Thanks for having me along.
No need to thank me! Come by again whenever you feel like it. You're welcome anytime.
Hm? You had enough?
Yeah. Thanks for inviting me along. I had a good time.
Yeah? Great to hear it! The fish you caught will only weigh you down, so I'll get them sent to your place later.
I must say, you're pretty good at fishing. I haven't been having much luck lately on my end.
In fact, I was just thinking about changing to a different spot.
You're welcome to tag along if you feel up to it.
Where are you headed next?
Out to sea. Sea fishing's my specialty!
Sea fishing? Right now? Huh, you don't mess around.
Hahaha, no, I sure don't! It's my policy to always act on something whenever I get the idea.
For example, I wanted to be a pilot when I was a kid, so I ended up joining the Air Self-Defense Force!
So you're a former self-defense official? What do you do for work now?
We'll get to that later. The name's Kimura, by the way. How about yourself?
I'm Suzuki. I drive a taxi here in town.
A taxi driver, huh? I take it you're off duty today?
Yeah, something like that.
Then what do you say, Suzuki-san? Want to come sea fishing? We can catch all sorts of fish out there, like tuna, flounder, and sea bream.
(Sea fishing? That could take a while, but it's not often I get a chance like this.)
Well, what's the verdict? You're welcome to fish here if you want. I could lend you a fishing rod and some bait.
(He's river fishing. I doubt there'd be many fish in there, though.)
Hmm? Can I help you?
Oh, I was just wondering if there's actually something to catch here.
There aren't many fish around, to be sure. But that doesn't mean there are none.
Can you tell me what the local fish are?
Carp, koi, and catfish mainly. There are also a few goby around.
That's more than I would've expected.
Hah, I guess so! I'm more of a sea fishing man myself, but there's nothing quite like taking a break here in one of the quieter corners of town.
How about you give it a try? We could do some fishing together if you want. I'd even lend you a fishing rod and some bait.
(Fishing, huh? Now that could be interesting.)
Okay, I'd like that. As long as it's not too much trouble, that is. Can I borrow that equipment you mentioned?
Whoops. I've got three pieces of bait to give you, but it doesn't look like you have room for them.
Okay, I'd like that. Hope it's not too much to ask.
Not at all! Come on over, then. No doubt you'll get plenty of fish if you're next to me!
No, I'd better pass for now. Sorry to bother you.
You sure? Well, you know where to find me if you change your mind.
Let's wrap up for now, Suzuki-san. How have you done so far?
I've caught one. How about you, Kimura-san?
I've caught two. How about you, Kimura-san?
I've caught three. How about you, Kimura-san?
Yeah? Same here. I guess that makes it a draw!
This was the most fun I've had in a while! Let me treat you to something for keeping me company here.
No luck at all. I haven't caught a thing.
I see. I got a few myself, so I guess I win for today.
Oh, I wouldn't want to impose.
You wouldn't be imposing! I'm only going to give you what we caught here!
I'll go fillet our catch over at my restaurant. It's in Nagasu, so I hope you'll stop by a bit.
You run a restaurant, Kimura-san?
That's right. I don't know if you've heard of it. It's called Sushi Zanmai.
We're open 24/7, all year round. They even call me the Tuna King down at the port.
The Tuna King? Hey, I know that name. So you're who that is.
One of my coworkers was talking about you. He was saying how Sushi Zanmai was run by some legendary Tuna King.
Hahahah! Well, that saves me the explanation! Okay, Suzuki-san. Let's head to my restaurant!
I'm not working today, so it's on the house!
River fishing is fun enough, but the sea's where I really like to be! I hope you have a blast, Suzuki-san!
I'm sure I will.
Okay, let's have a little contest. Make it a bit more interesting.
How about we see who can catch the most tuna?
Heh, all right then. I'll have you know this isn't my first time fishing at sea.
Then this should be good! I can use all the little tricks I've got up my sleeve! Feel free to use that bait I gave you.
You have three attempts to catch as many tuna as you can out at sea.
All ready to go, Suzuki-san! I made a seafood rice bowl from what we caught earlier. I hope you like it.
Heh, I feel a little guilty getting served by the owner of a famous sushi chain.
Hahahah! Don't you worry about that! We're fishing buddies now!
Just enjoy the delicate flavors and the thick, fatty textures of the seafood bowl I made you. It doesn't get fresher than this!
I'll dig in, then.
(...This is incredible! Made with fresh fish cut up right in front of me by the Tuna King himself! What a rare treat.)
How do you like it, Suzuki-san?
I'm almost speechless. It's perfect.
Yeah!? I thought you might say that!
See, I made this dish with the way you fish in mind.
You did?
Indeed. At first glance, one might think your fishing form unrefined, but a closer look reveals your fine control and raw power⑬the envy of any fisherman!
I just knew I had to capture that beauty in the form of sashimi on rice! I shall dub my new creation... the Dragon Seafood Bowl!
Seafood as raw as a dragon's strength... I guess that fits the dish pretty well.
It does, doesn't it? This'll be a hit! I'll add it to the Sushi Zanmai menu straightaway!
Just like that? Aren't you going to test it out or something first?
Nope! Like I told you, I always act on impulse⑬they're hardly ever wrong! And if they are, I'll own up to it! Besides, this is my way of saying thanks for the inspiration.
If I hadn't run into you, I'd probably still be at that river, wracking my brain for new menu ideas!
Heh, is that right? Then I'm glad I came by.
As am I, friend! You're always welcome to fish with me anytime.
Oh, and stop by the restaurant sometime! Sushi Zanmai would love to have you back!

The Dragon Seafood Bowl has been added to the menu
at each branch of Sushi Zanmai.
I spent a fortune on UFO Catchers and came up empty. Is there some secret technique?
There's only one skill you need: charming a clerk into repositioning prizes so they're easy to grab.
That's just great.
Hey, Ta-chan. What do you say to that offer I made? I'd like you to work here and try to catch that pesky shoplifter.
Sure. I'll give it a shot.
Oh, yeah! You're the man. Can you hop on the register right away?
Nah, I'll pass.
You sure? Well, it was worth a shot.

Hey, is everything cool? You look kinda down⑬I can tell
even with that mask on.

Oh, hi, Ta-chan. Yeah, we got shoplifter trouble. Some
punk decided to use us as his personal pantry.

He's been sneaking off with things like soda and snacks...
even dirty magazines! And gets away with it. Every. Single.
Time!
Huh, sounds annoying. There sure are a lot of troublemakers out there!
Speaking of trouble, guys like you shamelessly asking for expired bento boxes are about as much of a nuisance.
Says you. You never give me any, even when I ask nicely.
What do you expect? This isn't a soup kitchen.
Besides, if I did give expired food away, who knows how many other freeloaders would catch on? There'd be no end to it.
Sheesh, is this what I get for asking how you're doing?
Ah, no, I didn't mean to blow up at you. I'm just stressed because of that stupid shoplifter.

Yeah, but with the way you're circling around your store
like a hawk, customers will be too scared to come in.
Unfortunately, right now, all our customers look like crooks to me.
I know! Ta-chan, how would you like to take home an expired bento today?
Huh? Really? Why the sudden change of heart?
I was hoping I could get you to work here in return. Just for a while.
Huh? Work? Like, you want me to man the counter?
Yup. And, if you can, I'd like you to catch our shoplifter.
Oh, now I get it.
I just thought you looked like you could handle yourself in a fight. Besides, you're not all that busy, are you?
What, I look like I'm always loitering around to you?
That's exactly what I'm saying.
...Yeah, you have a point.
I'm serious, though. I really am in a bind here, and I could use all the help I can get.
Even if the shoplifter doesn't show, I'll pay you for the time you work. And that's on top of the bento.
(So he wants me to be a convenience store clerk? It's not a bad deal, what with the pay and the lunch.)
What do you say, Ta-chan? Can you do it?
I'm hungry. How about we drop in somewhere for a bite instead of eating at home?
Okay, but it's not because you don't want to eat my cooking, is it?
Uh... Of course not! Not at all! Ahaha...
No one's gonna mind. C'mon, just a little. Real talk, where's the harm in just a drink or two?
Did you forget that your poor wife banned you from drinking? Think of your health.
No, don't side with that teetotaler! Just a little! She won't even know. C'mon! Come ooon!
What are you, twelve?
Sorry to keep ya waitin'! Here's yer order.
Thank you, my good man. Kudos to you, for making it across such a slick street.
If you wanna praise someone, it should be that delivery guy over there. I'm just helpin' him because of how dedicated he is to his job.
Ah, a true professional. Well, I'm sure this ramen will be all the tastier for it.
Heh, enjoy.
Huh? Oh, it's you, Suzuki-san.
Done for the day, Muramatsu-san?
Nope, not quite. Anyway, there something I can help you with?
Uh, not exactly, no. I just saw you there, and thought I'd say hello.
You sure? No ulterior motive whatsoever? Huh. You're a lot friendlier than I gave you credit for.
Like I said, I was just passing by, and...
You gotta be kidding me!
That you, Kiryu-san? Man, you're the last guy I expected to run into out here!
(Not good!)
Sure has been a while since you last swung by the club! You remember your old pal Yuya, right? From Stardust?
(How could I forget? He manages the number one host club in Kamurocho... So what's he doing out here!?)
You know this guy, Suzuki-san? And what's this whole "Kiryu-san" business?
Huh? Uh... Who's Suzuki-san?
(Of course Yuya wouldn't know I'm hiding my identity...)
You must have the wrong guy. My name is Suzuki.
How could I be wrong, Kiryu-san? I'd know you from a mile away.
It must just be a chance resemblance. They say there are always three others who look exactly like you, somewhere in the world.
Come on, Kiryu-san, stop messing around! You're not just pulling my leg?
Sorry to interrupt, but who are you?
Uh, I have to get going, Muramatsu-san.
Whoa, what's the rush? What about this guy you know here?
Guy I know? What guy?
Me, of course! What happened to you, man!?
Oh, would you look at the time. I'd better head in to work.
Work? Kiryu-san, don't tell me you work in some stuffy office now!
Say, who's this "Kiryu-san" you keep talking about?
Who's Kiryu-san, you ask? Only the Dragon of Dojima himself!
The Dragon of Dojima? Never heard of it. Can I ask who you are?
Oh, the name's Yuya. I work as a host in Tokyo. Me and Kiryu-san here go way back.
Anyway, I thought you were still in Okinawa, so it's strange running into you here. Small world, huh?
What's this all about, Suzuki-san? This Yuya fellow seems to think he knows you.
Of course I do. Tell him, Kiryu-san.
(I have to find a way out of this mess! What's my best move?)
Do I really look that much like this Kiryu-san guy you know?
Look like? C'mon, I know it's you.
No, you must have made some mistake. I've never heard of this mystery man you're talking about.
Enough already! I don't know any Kiryu-san, and I don't plan on listening to any more of your nonsense!
That's it! I'd know that voice anywhere... Nobody else has that commanding presence or power! If you're not Kazuma Kiryu, then I don't know who is!
For the last time, I'm Suzuki!
...I don't get it. Why're you trying so hard to avoid me?
(Damn it. What do I do now?)
Hey, Suzuki-san. You don't think this guy's... trying to scam you, do ya?
